description: This file contains utility functions for exporting dashboard configurations into various formats: HTML, PDF, and PowerPoint. It leverages external libraries such as Jinja2 for templating, FPDF for PDF generation, and python-pptx for PowerPoint creation. The functions facilitate rendering a dashboard config to HTML, converting HTML to PDF (rudimentary), and generating PPT presentations based on dashboard widgets.

methods.name: str dashboard_to_html(dashboard_config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a dashboard configuration dictionary into an HTML string using a Jinja2 template.

methods.name: generate_pdf_from_html(html: str, pdf_path: str)
methods.description: Creates a PDF file from an HTML string using FPDF. Note: FPDF is used here in a basic way that does not parse HTML content.

methods.name: generate_ppt_from_dashboard(dashboard_config: Dict[str, Any], ppt_path: str)
methods.description: Generates a PowerPoint presentation file from a dashboard configuration with slides for the title and each widget.
